name: Banh beo
summary: Bánh bèo here is a bột lọc cake with shrimp or pork and a heavy hand of herbs.
origin: Vinh. The 24 November 2022 city page describes the cake. The 28 April 2023 Báo Nghệ An page puts it on Đào Tấn.
howToEat: Order it in the afternoon on the city page, or at the fixed kitchens on Đào Tấn. The city page says bột lọc, shrimp or pork, and a lot of herbs.
where: Đường Đào Tấn, from cửa Hữu to cửa Tả, on the 27 April 2023 Báo Nghệ An account. Fixed kitchens on that account were allowed 24 hours. A 2026 night list was not opened.
seoTitle: Banh beo in Vinh — shrimp or pork cake
seoDescription: Bánh bèo here is a bột lọc cake with shrimp or pork and a heavy hand of herbs.
